body:
Changelog:
- Support for Android/Google TV. Entire UI is now navigable with D-Pad. Includes pairing support for TVs running Android 14+ (See #30)
- Fixed Shizuku User Service not working on MediaTek devices (See RikkaApps/Shizuku [#1171](https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku/issues/1171) and [#1198](https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku/issues/1198))
- Watchdog is now opt-in to comply with Google policies. **IMPORTANT: If you use watchdog, please go to settings and re-enable watchdog if it got disabled after the update**
- Added a toggle to grant/revoke Shizuku permission for all apps at once (See #42)
- Toggling TCP mode now shows a prompt to restart Shizuku if it was already running, so that the setting takes effect immediately. Shizuku will wait for Wi-Fi before restarting to minimize downtime (See #43)
